purpose: Bounded current-environment probes before the unchanged exact harness verification test. No verification substitution.

shellProbe.command: for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do result=$(grep -qE no_such_line Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null); done; exit 0

localeProbe.command: for ((i=0;i<1000;i++)); do if grep -qE 'API_KEY\s*=\s*[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}' Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi; done

decision: No material runtime improvement established. Preserve inherited verification environment and do not install replacement utilities.
